items.text: The November Core Update still moves rankings, and Glenn Gabe sees scaled AI content drop hard. Judge drops in GSC, not Nov. 18 rank data, and audit thin location pages.
In David Konitzny's data, only 51.8% of AIOs put the first link in the first third on Nov. 20, down from 76.8% in September. Recheck AIO citations for priority keywords.
WordPress 7.1.5 fixes 18 flaws, and 7.2 ships Dec. 8 with a /random/ URL on by default. Update client sites now, and decide which ones need code to turn /random/ off.
Ahrefs found that about 3 in 4 lost AI citations were temporary, and half came back within three days. Report citation trends over two or three weeks, not single checks.
Google told CMOs that their content, not AI, made their brands invisible in Search. Check each planned post for first-hand knowledge, original data and a named expert before we write it.
Since Nov. 16, Ask Maps can call local businesses to check open times and prices. Check each local client's GBP call setting, and tell staff that their answers go back to the customer.
